title: Closed Areas Regulation, Schedule 5.1, section 4 (McGuire and Tamihi Creek Forest Service Roads)

source.version: BC Laws consolidation current to October 13, 2026

source_text:
Schedule 5.1 [en. B.C. Reg. 135/2017, App. 1, s. 2.] No Shooting Areas — Specified Crown Land (Section 7.1)
McGuire and Tamihi Creek Forest Service Roads
4 Those portions of M.U. 2-3 being all Crown land within 400 m of the midline of the following roads: (a)McGuire Forest Service Road from the junction with the Tamihi Creek Forest Service Road to the crossing of an unnamed creek approximately 3 km easterly along the McGuire Forest Service Road; (b)Tamihi Creek Forest Service Road from the junction with the Liumchen Forest Service Road to the crossing of Tamihi Creek approximately 6 km southerly and easterly along the Tamihi Creek Forest Service Road. [am. B.C. Reg. 115/2018, App. 1, s. 3.]
